title: Lazar named element 115 as fuel in 1989, before its 2003 synthesis

tellings.quote: Lazar described element 115 as the fuel source for the craft's propulsion system. [music] Mind you, this was in 1989, before element 115 had ever been synthesized [music] or named.

plain: In 1989 a man named Bob Lazar, who says he worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site called S4, described element 115, a superheavy chemical element, as the fuel for the craft's propulsion. Michels stresses that this was before element 115 had ever been made in a lab or named, which happened in 2003. He tells it himself after spending two days with Lazar, as a sign that Lazar knew something before the world did.
